newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers firmer amid tight supply.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers firmer amid tight supply.

text.p: North American bunker prices were firmer late this week as fuel shortages and demand worked together to drive up prices in the East and West Coasts, players said Thursday.
Bunker fuel was reported out in New York Harbor due to suppliers who had kept their inventories light when the market was falling earlier this month.
Traders said they were trying to cover cargo requirments for suppliers from Venezuelan and Houston ports.
"There is nothing coming for a week to ten days," said one Harbor trader.
